title: Football stadium fans sing after a near miss by avakas
author: avakas
sourceDescription: Football game (soccer for the other side of the Atlantic), with a big crowd. A chance is lost and they sing or chant, say bravo and a hip-hip hurray. The stadium is of Aris F.C. in Greece more specifically.
